title: Client Kickoff Checklist
summary: Prepare the goal, scope, decision owner, materials and next steps for a client kickoff conversation.

title: Portfolio Case Study Outline
summary: Explain the problem, your contribution, evidence, decisions and outcomes of one design project.

title: Research Interview Planner
summary: Plan neutral questions about a recent real experience and separate observations from interpretations.

title: Landing Page Review Sheet
summary: Review one landing page for audience clarity, promise, proof, action and mobile usability.

title: Accessibility Spot Check
summary: Inspect keyboard use, labels, headings, contrast and error feedback, then record issues for follow-up.

title: Weekly Design Practice Planner
summary: Choose one design skill, plan short practice sessions, record feedback and set the next exercise.
